lessons_used: Reordering flow steps generated several significant wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risk (-8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Interactive flows (+6.5% to +7.2%) and interactive waiting screen features (+3.9%) were helpful and beat predictions.
UI redesigns failed to yield any wins, often caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%), and performed worse than predicted.
Targeted copy updates were helpful for account persistence (+3.5%) and launch actions (+6.7%), though other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Hints produced no wins, either actively hurting performance (-3.1%) or showing no clear effect.
Notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens showed no clear effect across all rounds.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Habitat Customizer Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive habitat customization component to the companion selection screen allowing users to pick a desktop environment theme before finalizing.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the highest drop-off with only 60.9% conversion and long median duration (89s). Interactive customization flows drive strong engagement.

guard.reason: Habitat selection is added to pick_friend while retaining pet choice and adhering to onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Interactive flow directly targets the largest funnel drop-off step (adoption at 60.9%).

lessons_next: Interactive flow additions consistently won (up to +14.8%) and frequently outperformed predictions.
Reordering flow steps produced large wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risk (down to -8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates yielded wins for persistence notices (+3.5%) and launch buttons (+6.7%), though other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting screen features produced a win (+3.9%), but mostly showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns failed to win, performed worse than predicted, and frequently caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%).
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens yielded no wins, with hints sometimes hurting performance (-3.1%) and others showing no clear effect.
